scope: Implementation and local automated regression only; physical platform acceptance remains NOT_RUN and no release gate is closed
implementation: Account-bound Web microphone preference is confirmed and saved independently of probe or call presence; first capture receives the selected exact device constraint.

One serialized microphone adapter owns switching, rollback/default fallback, reconnect, processor lifecycle and source-ended handling. Terminal failure revokes prior enable intent and deafen restoration until explicit unmute.
Probe reads the confirmed input or borrows the call track; it neither changes the selection nor stops a borrowed call stream.

Flutter regression exposed that setDeviceId on a temporarily muted SDK track changes options without recapture. The controller now uses existing restartTrack while muted, then restores current intent or rolls back through the same SDK. Vendored SDK and native platform hooks were not changed.
audio.input.switch has a closed platform/phase/result vocabulary. Backend relay drops all device identifiers, labels, errors and unknown fields and derives platform from the validated resource.

reproduction.web_before_fix: Prejoin selection was component-local, not persisted or passed into first capture.
reproduction.native_before_fix: Active selection test saw one getUserMedia rather than two: setDeviceId on muted track did not restart capture.
reproduction.safety_before_fix: Two added tests failed: recovery automatically enabled capture and deafen retained enable intent after a terminal input fault.

environment.media: Two Web Audio oscillator tracks at 440/880 Hz; real SDK publisher and receiver, disposable loopback-only SFU. No physical microphone, recording or audio artifacts.

assertions: Prejoin dropdown selection triggers no capture and first call capture requests mic-2; receiver hears 880 Hz.
Active switch changes peer frequency to 440 Hz without probe.
Muted switch and full reconnect remain silent; explicit unmute restores the selected input.
Deafen switches remain silent and successful undeafen restores prior intent.
Selected input unplug falls back with warning; losing all inputs silences capture with error.
Prejoin probe cleans up its owned stream; active probe does not create or stop call capture.
Reload retains account selection; listener-only selection does not acquire capture.
